scope: Ordinary offline peer review of saved-response binding, atomic application/undo, source navigation, exact numeric display and copied reference meaning. Node plus explicit DOM stubs; no browser or formal red team.

findings.original: A manually entered response decoded_json_pointer displayed nested JSON but copied only the raw response pointer.
findings.repair: Response document decoded pointers reject explicitly; raw response pointers remain available. Unavailable/error navigation clears displayed value and copied citation.

findings.original: Loading finding-9007199254740991 and clicking Add twice created duplicate finding-9007199254740992 identifiers; export failed Duplicate finding ID after required fields supplied.
findings.repair: New-view capture listener selects unused small suffix before unchanged original Add handler. Imported identifiers stay exact; add/remove/export/undo checked for maximum-safe, larger and mixed-case gap IDs.

validation.combined_recheck: 74 passed = 11 independent + 43 draft + 20 renderer tests; recheck-tests.log
validation.final_independent: 14 passed; final-independent.log. Three additional add/remove/export/undo cases added after combined recheck, total 77 distinct passing cases across logs.
validation.initial_peer: 1 failed, 10 passed. Renderer was already narrowly repaired between the two-defect reproduction and this later regression run; initial-probes.json and complete-export-probes.json preserve both original failures.
validation.dom_model: Owner harness retains capture and target-phase listeners; both new capture allocator and unchanged legacy Add callback execute, rather than overwriting a single fake listener.

positive_checks: Exact incident, raw, model-assisted, initial-adjudication and resolver response identities/contents round-trip through actual form serializer and Python response validation.
Preview does not mutate; undo restores preceding form including tested pending content.
Large saved IDs and mixed-case finding IDs survive allocation/removal; final current IDs remain unique.
Arbitrary large integer, precise decimal, negative-zero and null source lexemes display without Number rounding.
Missing documents, missing paths and malformed decoded JSON remain unavailable and clear stale citations; malformed raw JSON stays inspectable.
Existing 63 source/draft tests cover invalid bindings, atomic rollback, cancellation races, unsupported shapes, pagination and actual source references.
limits: No actual browser event/layout/accessibility or human usability validation.
No authentication, human validity, clinical performance or comparative value conclusion.
No new model calls, network, repository edits or original artifact mutations.
